name: National Museum of Fine Arts of Chile (MNBA)
known: Juan Mochi was its first director (Spanish Wikipedia).
Director: Varinia Brodsky Zimmermann (The Art Newspaper, July 2026).

Spanish Wikipedia says, in its account of the director who left before 2012, that the museum received 800 million pesos a year from the state, against 1,300 million for the Centro Cultural Palacio de La Moneda.

name: Red Brick Art Museum
known: Founded by the collector and entrepreneur Yan Shijie (阎士杰) and his wife Cao Mei.
The founders invested nearly RMB 400 million over eight years, and the museum opened in May 2014 (Our China Story, Chinese edition: "投资近4亿人民币，历时8年", our translation).
Founder Yan is described only as a collector and entrepreneur; no reporting found of his company or the source of his wealth.

name: UCCA Center for Contemporary Art
known: 2017 sale: investors led by Jason Jiang, founder of Focus Media, and the education company Future Edutainment bought the centre (The Art Newspaper).

name: Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea
He Art Museum
known: Founded by He Jianfeng and his father He Xiangjian, founder of Midea Group.
Shao Shu, formerly of Shanghai's Long Museum, was founding director (ArtAsiaPacific).
The name He (和) is the founder's family name and means "harmony, balance and mixture" (Wikipedia).
